adaptations: Nested React element/type leaves remain identity values before classification. The exact pinned plain-object predicate selects incoming recursion, preserving Date/Map/Set/RegExp/typed-array/class instances and excluded tagged/iterable records.

Existing nested values are merged only when they are owned plain records; otherwise incoming plain data is cloned into a fresh record. Top-level native behavior, incoming-array replacement, eager Object.entries snapshots, undefined policy and dangerous-key filtering remain unchanged.

The React guard remains before prototype/symbol classification. Symbol presence tests never invoke symbol getters. Cross-realm/null-prototype and exception-phase controls execute against the actual pinned MUI source. Rejected ordinary-object guard repetition remains native-specific rather than a wholesale MUI deepmerge port.
No component callback, memo comparison or lazy loader executes during merge. Existing public Card state/ref regression verifies equivalent reconstructed themes preserve the configured root.
